implementation_authorization.rationale: UI1c5 adds integrated cross-form validation/release evidence only. It adds no GEL tutorial write, archive writer, teacher reassignment, persistence, or frontend semantic authority.

dependencies: selected A+D hybrid layout contract v3 or later
GRI0-GRI2 reproducible release controls before UI1c1
non_goals: No additional archive mutation capability; UI1c5 adds no new archive command and the pre-existing A2 ui1_sync_archive delegation remains the sole governed local archive synchronization trigger.
No Harper runtime or dictionary persistence; those remain UI1d.
No native close interception, stale-source reconciliation workflow, or full mocked E2E; those remain UI1e.
No frontend-owned GEL field IDs, CEFR ordering, assessment/exam domains, or validation rules.
global_invariants: React remains presentation-only; every semantic mutation traverses TutorialDraftEdit or a narrower Rust-owned replacement contract.
Candidate-before-commit remains mandatory: failed edits do not mutate the active draft.
New tutorial type is chosen from the selected-student command surface and causes authoritative reconstruction; there is no raw SetTutorialType edit.
Revision tutorial type, teacher attribution, source identity, and historical timestamp remain immutable.
All option domains rendered by React are projected from Rust safe view models; TypeScript does not duplicate canonical GEL value sets.
Field visibility is controlled by an executable tutorial-type applicability matrix, not ad-hoc React conditionals alone.
Hidden but applicable legacy fields must be deliberately PRESERVED_UNCHANGED; they may not be reset by unrelated UI edits.
Level regression protection compares only the same canonical semantic role and never infers equivalence across Initial/current roles or across skills.
UI1c1 may not begin from an unlocked dependency graph; GRI strict acceptance is the implementation authorization boundary.
Portable CI evidence cannot replace private/target-host strict acceptance and cannot automatically promote a candidate.
Accepted release packaging revalidates exact source identity and performs no build after strict acceptance.

amendments_required_before_or_during_UI1.problem: Target Initial UI requires HSP/G21/G15 course type stored in teacher comments, but current semantic state exposes teacher_comments only and does not give course type independent authority.
amendments_required_before_or_during_UI1.required_resolution: Define a Rust semantic InitialCourseType representation and explicit lossless mapping to/from Initial teacher_comments. Recognized exact values HSP/G21/G15 may become editable; unrecognized nonblank legacy text must be preserved until the user explicitly chooses a replacement. React must not parse or compose teacher-comments storage text.

amendments_required_before_or_during_UI1.problem: Target Standard UI calls for Aims presets/tick actions plus direct edit, but no current canonical preset source exists in UI1 contracts.
amendments_required_before_or_during_UI1.required_resolution: Treat the preset list as versioned Writer assistance content, separate from tutorial semantic state. Import only from an explicitly curated bundled JSON contract. Selecting a preset appends plain text through SetAims; direct editing remains authoritative. If no curated list is supplied, UI1c may ship the direct Aims editor but the preset control must remain absent rather than inventing text.

amendments_required_before_or_during_UI1.problem: Current Tauri edit failures are strings, insufficient for stable field-level validation presentation.
amendments_required_before_or_during_UI1.required_resolution: Introduce a serializable Rust validation/error DTO with stable code, semantic field, severity, message, and optional prior/candidate values. No UI string parsing to recover field identity.

rules: Overall level options originate from Rust.
Teacher is read-only/omittable and never an edit target.

must_preserve_hidden: none of Initial/Final-only state may be introduced

initial.course_type_storage: explicit Rust semantic adapter to Initial teacher_comments; no React storage mapping
initial.hidden_policy: Existing/default GEL exam fields remain unchanged in UI1c unless a later product decision explicitly authorizes controls; ordinary Initial edits must not reset them.

final.reading: optional and non-blocking; no Initial-reading concept is introduced
final.pairing_rule: Initial/current roles are displayed as explicit paired columns/rows but remain distinct semantic fields.
must_preserve_hidden: no Standard assessment/Aims or Initial exam fields may be introduced

level_regression_policy.comparison_source: N2c prepopulation source / latest authoritative tutorial, same canonical semantic field-role only
level_regression_policy.blocking_rule: If a New draft candidate lowers a populated CEFR field below the latest authoritative value for the same field-role, reject with LEVEL_REGRESSION.
level_regression_policy.overall_level: compare New overall_level to latest authoritative overall_level when both are known
level_regression_policy.revision_rule: Revision editing does not compare against a later tutorial; it remains governed by source identity and type applicability.

test_scenarios: New Standard opens with N2c values and only Standard controls; all 7 assessment edits are independently typed.
New Initial renders Initial roles only; HSP/G21/G15 selection changes only the governed course-type semantic/storage adapter.
Revision Initial with unknown teacher-comment text does not destroy that text through unrelated edits.
New Final shows Initial/current pairs and optional Reading without Initial Reading.
Changing one skill never copies/promotes a value into another skill or Initial/current role.
New same-role CEFR regression is rejected with structured LEVEL_REGRESSION issue; Revision is not compared against later tutorials.
Aims direct editing preserves newline semantics; governed hotlist, when present, only appends selected text.
Standard teacher comment 970 accepted / 971 rejected in Rust.
No UI1c action can set teacher, identity, timestamp, raw GEL field, or tutorial type on an active draft.
Switching desired New type occurs by leaving/reopening from explicit selected-student action and reconstructs authoritative form state rather than mutating the current draft.
